 Eng 101-1 published at 12 overs 12 overs 
 Back-to-back fours for Ben Duckett.
 He nails a pull shot through mid-wicket off Mahli Beardman, then sends the ball fine for another boundary.
 That's England's hundred up - they're going at over eight an over presently.

 England’s highest powerplay scores in Australia (ODIs):
 87-2 - Melbourne, 2018

 WICKET published at 8.4 overs 8.4 overs 
 Banton c Marsh b Edwards 44 (Eng 73-1) 
 England's form man departs - and it's a fantastic catch from Mitchell Marsh that sends him on his way!
 Tom Banton hits Jack Edwards - who replaced Mahli Beardman after one over - high in the air and Marsh chased the ball over his shoulder at mid-off.
 He caught the ball, saw it rise from his hands as he fell, recovered somewhat before losing it for a second time.
 The ball bounced off his chest and then the Australia skipper secured his, bringing his hands to his body to complete the catch.
 The umpires check it, but that's fine - Banton goes for 44.

 Eng 58-0 published at 7 overs 7 overs 
 A good response from Mahli Beardman, immediately sending the ball past the outside edge of Tom Banton's bat.
 However the England opener gets stuck in later in the over, driving straight down the ground for another four.
 No strike-retaining single for Banton in this over - he has 44 from 33 deliveries, while Duckett, who hasn't faced since the last ball of the fourth over, has nine from nine.
